metadata.source: NOAA ENC Direct to GIS, Harbor.Sea_Area_Named_Water_Area
metadata.geometry_policy: Original source geometries are preserved individually. No dissolve, gap filling, boundary interpolation, or ecological/legal boundary claim is made.
limitations: NOAA ENC Direct to GIS is not certified for navigation.
Source chart dates range from 2002 to 2011.
Charted named-water polygons are not complete ecological or statutory boundaries.
Charted mud-flat classification does not establish current substrate or habitat suitability.
